abstract class CarEvent {}

class LoadCars extends CarEvent {}

issue.body:
When the app starts and the user reaches the car listing screen, the loading indicator keeps showing and the list of cars never appears.

The cars are being fetched from Firebase Firestore. The issue seems to happen during the process of loading the cars from the data source and passing the result through the repository and BLoC.

Expected behavior:
The car list should load from Firebase and be displayed on the car listing screen.

Actual behavior:
The loading indicator remains visible and no cars are displayed.

This started happening on the home/car listing screen. Other parts of the app appear to load normally.
issue.title: Cars keep loading indefinitely on the home screen
